title: Chaligny as trumpeter and bandleader
summary: Chaligny had retired from playing by then; he was a trumpeter and reportedly once had his own brass band.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Had he played, see we naturally never got to talk to him and I never knew him and don't know much about him. Can you tell us anything about what instruments he played especially well or did he ever work? Do you remember as a musician much?
Yeah, he played dances or anything? I remember he was too old at that time. He had quit playing and retired and he was teaching. He played the trumpet.
Yeah, yeah. But he could play.
Did he ever say which bands he had been with? Any brass bands or dance bands or did he have his own band? Do you know?
I heard of he had his own brass band. But I never did know the name of it, the brass band, but I heard that he played in old brass band.
